Name: Slightly Nicer Stable
Author: erzvolnes
Description:
A small mod that cleans up the stable a little without dramatically changing the vanilla art.  

[list]
[*]Removes rust and damage. 
[*]Fills trough with water.
[*]Edits water bucket to contain grain instead. 
[*]Removes blanket (?) from the corner.
[*]Removes hay patch from floor.
[*]OPTIONALLY - adds a hay pile for your horse to 'graze' on while idling. 
[/list]
I am not a pixel artist and 90% of the changes were made by copying assets from elsewhere in the game. Slightly inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7397]Clean Stable by Oklinq[/url]. 

If you have any suggestions for further edits, let me know! I'm happy to tinker away and make some new versions. 

INSTALLATION: 

[list]
[*]Make sure you have both SMAPI and Content Patcher.
[*]Download whichever version of this mod you want. 
[*]Unzip the mod folder into StardewValley/Mods.
[*]Launch the game.
[*]Done!
[/list]
